name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Luna Sauna Canadian Timber 2-4 Person | CTC22LU
description: Description This Canadian Timber Luna Sauna is handcrafted from Eastern White Cedar, this sauna is strong for all-weather outdoor use, resistant to rot and decay, and features a beautiful light-colored finish. The door is 0.2 in (5mm) bronze tempered glass with a wooden frame and pre-hung on the front wall for easy installation. This Luna Sauna kit comes with 2 tier prefab benches for 2-4 person seating , solid cedar floor joists, floor and walls , white cedar bevel siding for the sides, and is packaged in a ready-to-assemble kit . The large bronze tinted window allows you to enjoy the view outside without others peeking in and the rounded corners of the sauna offer a modern, unique design that perfectly fits into a modern or rustic setting. Features: Seats: 2-4 people Size: 7' cube / 280 cu ft Wood: Eastern White Cedar Walls: 1.5" Thick Solid Cedar Door: Full-Sized Door with Bronze-Tempered Window for Easy Access Window: D ouble pane 5mm bronze tempered glass Weight : 1525 lbs Made in: Canada Dimensions Included Includes: Full sauna kit: Pre-cut tongue & groove white cedar for full sauna structure Prefab 2-tier solid benches Bronze tempered glass window Waterproof roof membrane Cedar roof boards Door w/ bronze tempered glass window Hardware Installation guide & video Heater sold separately Choose a matched heater package in the heater options on this page, or contact us if you'd like a different heater. Sauna Accessories Add a Cold Plunge Tub , Outdoor Shower , Backrests , Bucket & Ladle , Lights , Thermometer , and Sand Timer to create the ultimate relaxation haven.
